summary: Yutaka Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company specializing in the production of precision machined parts for the semiconductor industry. Established in 1981, the company focuses on quality, cost, and delivery to meet the demands of electronic components sectors, employing a PDCA cycle for quality and environmental management.
